items.text: CNA has no counterpart of XNA 4.0's draw-time check GraphicsDevice.VerifyCanDraw, which throws InvalidOperationException (MissingVertexShaderInput) when the bound VertexDeclaration lacks a semantic the current vertex shader reads. StockEffectUsesVertexSemantic encodes the per-variant table but is used only to decide consumed streams; EasyGL, OPENGL4, SDL_GPU and WEBGPU then feed a missing secondary input from the (0, 0, 0, 1) neutral record (e.g. DualTextureEffect's TEXCOORD1 on a one-UV mesh, a texture coordinate for a textured BasicEffect on EasyGL/OpenGL4), so draws XNA refuses succeed.

items.text: Renderers disagree on a stock-effect draw whose declaration lacks a semantic the effect reads. WEBGPU substitutes: EnvironmentMapEffect without NORMAL0/TEXCOORD0 and non-skinned PbrEffect on a non-PBR stride fall through to a BasicEffect shape (lit/textured/coloured), and AlphaTestEffect (non-Always compare) or DualTextureEffect without TEXCOORD0 reach WebGPURenderer::DrawColoredPrimitives, which draws a stride-16 position+colour buffer untextured. SDL_GPU throws NotSupportedException for the same alpha-test/dual/env-map/PBR cases (std::invalid_argument for SkinnedEffect). VULKAN aliases TEXCOORD1 onto TEXCOORD0 for DualTextureEffect (VULKAN-150) where EasyGL/OpenGL4/SDL_GPU/WebGPU read (0,0). SDL_GPU and WEBGPU drop BasicEffect texturing/lighting the declaration cannot feed, while EasyGL/OpenGL4 run the textured/lit program with neutral inputs.
